name: Airtable nonprofit plans
summary: A database-style workspace for tracking programs, relationships and work.
cost: 50% off the monthly per-user Team plan rate.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Legal nonprofit registration is required. International applicants can qualify. Political, religious, health-related and foundation exclusions apply.
limits: The annual billing discount does not stack. Airtable AI is excluded. Confirm who counts as a billable collaborator.

name: Asana for nonprofits
summary: Project and task management for teams.
cost: 50% off Starter or Advanced after approval.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Qualifying 501(c)(3) organizations, equivalent international organizations and qualifying public libraries can apply. Hospitals and hospital auxiliaries are excluded.
limits: Select the team size in the provider application. Enterprise requires a separate conversation with Asana.

name: Atlassian for nonprofits
summary: Discounts across work management, knowledge sharing and related apps.
cost: The provider advertises 50–100% off eligible Atlassian apps.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Nonprofits and social enterprises must apply for a Social Impact License and meet the current eligibility rules.
limits: The offer depends on the app and arrangement. Check the current license terms, user limits and covered products rather than assuming one discount applies to everything.

name: Canva Nonprofits
summary: Design tools for campaigns, presentations and shared brand material.
cost: Free access to Canva Pro features and collaboration tools for up to 50 users.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Registered organizations must satisfy Canva’s eligibility guidelines and receive approval.
limits: The team limit and excluded organization types matter. Check the current guidelines before inviting a whole organization.

sources.label: Offer, team size and eligibility link

name: GitHub for Nonprofits
summary: Code collaboration and project infrastructure for registered nonprofits.
cost: Free GitHub Team, or 25% off GitHub Enterprise Cloud for qualifying organizations.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Qualified 501(c)(3) or equivalent organizations and libraries can apply. Program exclusions and organization verification apply.
limits: Plan discounts do not cover other subscriptions or usage-based billing. Manage Actions, storage and other metered usage separately.

name: Google Ad Grants
summary: A grant for search advertising that can help people find your work.
cost: Up to US$10,000 per month in eligible Google Search ads. This is advertising credit, not cash.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Qualifying organizations must apply through Google for Nonprofits and activate Ad Grants.
limits: The amount available is not a promise of ad delivery, donations or results. Account and advertising rules apply.

name: Google Workspace for Nonprofits
summary: Email at your domain, shared files, documents, calendars and meetings.
cost: The nonprofit-specific Workspace plan is listed at $0 per user per month. Discounted upgrades are separate.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Google must verify the organization. Product availability varies by country.
limits: Check current storage, meeting and administrative limits. Approval for one Google product does not automatically activate every product.

name: Mailchimp nonprofit discount
summary: Discounted email marketing for communicating with supporters.
cost: 15% off for verified nonprofit organizations and charities.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: US applicants provide an EIN and may need an IRS determination letter. International applicants provide their website and may need more documentation.
limits: Request approval before purchasing a marketing plan. The provider does not give retroactive discounts or refunds for past purchases.

name: Microsoft 365 nonprofit pricing
summary: Discounted office, email, collaboration and security plans.
cost: Microsoft lists Business Premium at a 75% discount for eligible nonprofits.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Organizations must satisfy Microsoft’s nonprofit eligibility and licensing rules.
limits: This is discounted paid software. Verify the exact plan and which staff or volunteers may use each license; do not assume an old free Premium grant still exists.

name: Microsoft Azure nonprofit grant
summary: Cloud service credits for eligible nonprofit infrastructure.
cost: US$2,000 in Azure service credits per year.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Microsoft nonprofit validation and Azure grant setup are required.
limits: Credits are not cash. Check renewal, included services and how you will stop or pay for usage beyond the grant.

name: Miro for nonprofits
summary: A collaborative whiteboard for workshops and planning.
cost: 30% off paid plans for eligible nonprofit organizations.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Provide evidence of government-recognized nonprofit status and apply with an email at your organization’s domain. Individuals are not eligible.
limits: The terms include restrictions on combining promotions and a willingness to allow name/logo use and participate in a case study if requested. Read those terms before applying.

name: Notion for nonprofits
summary: A shared workspace for documents, knowledge and project tracking.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Notion verifies civil society organizations using submitted documents and public databases.
limits: Only the Business plan is covered. Organizations can request the discount for up to three workspaces.

name: Salesforce Power of Us
summary: Donated CRM licenses and related nonprofit discounts.
cost: 10 donated Enterprise Edition licenses in an approved product bundle; additional licenses and services can cost extra.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Eligible nonprofit and educational organizations apply with tax and legal documents. The provider says fiscal sponsorships can be accepted.
limits: Generally one donation per organization or tax identifier. Implementation, training, integrations and extra licenses are separate decisions. Review the exact bundle in the current portal.

name: Slack for Nonprofits
summary: A nonprofit program for team messaging and collaboration.
cost: Free Pro for eligible workspaces with 250 or fewer members; 85% off Pro above that size, or Business+ at any size.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Valid charitable status is required. Slack excludes specified organization types, including political activity organizations, schools, hospitals and private foundations.
limits: Applications are per workspace. No refunds for fees paid before approval. Read the full eligibility rules.

name: TechSoup technology offers
summary: A route to donated and discounted technology from multiple providers.
cost: Free membership is available. Individual offers can involve subscription, administrative or other charges; Plus membership is separate.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Eligibility is assessed for each provider and offer. Check the local TechSoup partner and the organization types supported.
limits: Membership does not make every listed product free or guarantee eligibility. Compare the full cost and renewal terms with the provider’s direct offer.

name: Zoom for Nonprofits
summary: Discounts on selected video meeting and webinar plans.
cost: 50% off selected annual Workplace Pro, Workplace Business, Large Meeting and Webinar plans.
fit: Check eligibility before choosing or paying for a plan.
eligibility: Qualifying nonprofits and public libraries with operating budgets of US$10 million or less. Goodstack verifies eligibility; listed education, healthcare and government organizations are excluded.
limits: Apply through Zoom Cares. The old TechSoup route has ended. Product limits and direct-sales account exclusions apply.
